final_message:
I added `tests/test_expiring_today.py`, and it fails for the reason in the scenario. It replays the recording: it adds milk expiring 2026-10-21 and yogurt expiring 2026-10-23, then asks for `GET /items/expiring?days=3&today=2026-10-21`. The expected list is milk then yogurt, taken from the recording's `expected` field. The API returns only yogurt, so milk, the item that runs out today, is missing.

I ran only the new test, not the whole suite. I touched no source and changed no existing assertions.
